text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A after large gains felt rewarding, but I should base future sales on my investment plan and valuation rather than the satisfaction of locking in gains.","My account value fluctuated meaningfully even without trading, so I should assess risk and diversification across the whole portfolio, not react to a single period’s return.","With a long horizon and infrequent trading, I should avoid unnecessary transactions and review my positions periodically against clear goals and risk limits."]}
